USE WAREHOUSE team_f_wh;
WITH base AS (
  SELECT CATEGORY_LEVEL_1, AGE_CATEGORY,
         COUNT(*) AS numer
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
  WHERE CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL AND AGE_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CATEGORY_LEVEL_1, AGE_CATEGORY
),
totals AS (
  SELECT CATEGORY_LEVEL_1, SUM(numer) AS denom
  FROM base GROUP BY CATEGORY_LEVEL_1
  HAVING SUM(numer) >= 1000
),
with_pct AS (
  SELECT b.CATEGORY_LEVEL_1, b.AGE_CATEGORY, b.numer, t.denom,
         ROUND(100.0 * b.numer / t.denom, 2) AS pct
  FROM base b JOIN totals t ON b.CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 = t.CATEGORY_LEVEL_1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS valid_questions,
       MIN(pct) AS min_pct, MAX(pct) AS max_pct, ROUND(AVG(pct),2) AS avg_pct,
       ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pct),2) AS p25,
       ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pct),2) AS p50,
       ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pct),2) AS p75
FROM with_pct WHERE pct BETWEEN 5 AND 95
